completion_data.completion_summary: Rewrote task.md step 4 with a 5-step keyword_overrides precedence chain enabling extensions to register task-type keywords and aliases; documented the schema in extension-development.md and updated CLAUDE.md merge source and live file.

memory_candidates.content: Extension keyword_overrides pattern: Extensions can register 'keyword_overrides' in manifest.json to claim task types during /task creation. Schema: {"task_type": {"aliases": [...], "keywords": [...]}}. Keywords are scanned using jq with whole-word matching (\b boundaries). Aliases remap hardcoded-table/project-default results only (not other extension keyword results). First-match-wins across manifests in glob order. Precedence: meta > extension keywords > project default > hardcoded table, with alias remapping after project default and hardcoded table steps.
